_comment: Copy this to spray_stats_config.json and fill it in. That file is gitignored - keep it that way, it holds credentials.
_auth: Use EITHER api_key on its own, OR username and password. --setextent edits a portal ITEM, which an api_key cannot do - that needs username and password.
_webmaps: Which web map belongs to which job. The script reads the day's Job_Number from the records and picks the matching map, so you cannot accidentally reposition another project's map. Keys must match Job_Number exactly. 'default' is used when a day has no job number at all.
